Several project management processes are going on at the same time during a project. It is important to recognize the concurrent management of areas such as scope, schedule, resources, cost and quality. Careful orchestration is essential to the discipline of good project management. Having an overview of the entire project, and not a particular mindset of where one is at in a lifecycle will result in better management efficiency.
To clearly document the baseline scope, key stakeholders, milestones and risks for the project.
